name: 镜头生图
body: Vertical 9:16 full-bleed Song dynasty garden, refined hand-painted Chinese animation background. Same old pavilion, willow and apricot tree across shots. Restrained ink wash and mineral pigments, jade-grey, ivory, ink-blue, small amber dusk accents. Quiet wistful late spring. Layered depth, delicate brushwork, credible architecture. Lower middle quiet for later subtitles. No modern objects, no text, calligraphy, seals, logos, borders or watermark. Shot: {{visual_intent}}
